## Checklist

- [ ] The spec comes first: new or different behavior changes the spec in `openspec/changes` in this pull request.
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior that this pull request adds or changes, and `scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] A change to the interface has screenshots in light and dark mode, made with the debug harness, with made-up names, IBANs, and amounts.
- [ ] A change that users notice has its entry under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`, written for users. Otherwise say here why it needs none.
- [ ] No personal data in fixtures, logs, or screenshots.
